_note: Same settings for every candidate. There is deliberately no per-candidate override.
cap_ordering: Keep items whose published_date is inside the candidate's campaign_period (if one is given). Sort newest first; break ties by URL. Keep the first N. Never ordered or picked by topic or content.

relevance.note: Format filter only: keeps recordings where the candidate is likely speaking at length. It is not a topic filter and never looks at what was said. Every item it drops is logged with its title.

user_agent_note: Browserbase's default browser user agent; we do not spoof, use stealth, proxies or CAPTCHA solving.
